body:
Abry Partners has hired Advent International managing director Yusef Kassim to lead its capital strategy and investor relations, seven years after the $16bn alternative investment manager last publicly announced the close of a flagship buyout fund.

Kassim has joined as head of capital strategy and investor relations, replacing retiring chief investor relations officer Pam Harris, who will become a senior adviser.

Abry closed its $2.1bn ninth flagship fund in 2019 and subsequently tested the market for Fund X.

The firm temporarily paused that fundraising process to allow Fund IX to become more fully invested and mature, ION Analytics reported last year. Abry CEO CJ Brucato declined to comment on the firm’s fundraising plans at the time.

Abry has since generated liquidity from Fund IX, including through a $780m continuation vehicle for Centauri Health Solutions completed in June.

Centauri was originally acquired through Fund IX in February 2020, with the continuation vehicle giving existing investors the option to take liquidity or remain invested in the business. Neuberger Private Markets and Apollo S3 led the transaction.

Abry also said in August that it had deployed equity across four investments and completed four exits during the first half of 2026.

Kassim joins after serving as a managing director at Advent, where he was responsible for institutional investor relationships and capital formation across North America and Latin America.

He brings more than 25 years of capital formation and business development experience across private equity, credit and hedge funds, having previously held senior roles at Blue Harbour Group, Eton Park and Gerson Lehrman Group after beginning his career at Goldman Sachs.

His move comes amid Advent pursuing one of the private equity industry’s biggest current fundraises, targeting $26bn for its eleventh flagship global private equity fund. It closed its predecessor, GPE X, on $25bn in 2022.

Brucato said Kassim’s appointment would help ensure Abry’s capital formation efforts reflected the “full scale and ambition” of its development as a multi-strategy platform.

Abry has expanded beyond its traditional private equity business across flagship buyouts, lower-middle-market Heritage funds, structured equity and private debt. Its newer liquid credit operation has grown to more than $1.6bn of assets across four CLOs since launching last year.

The firm has completed more than $90bn of leveraged transactions and other private or preferred equity investments since its foundation in 1989.

p: Abry Partners가 캐피탈 전략 및 Investor Relations를 총괄하도록 Advent International의 매니징 디렉터인 Yusef Kassim을 영입했다.
이 기사에 접근하려면 프리미엄 구독자가 되어야 합니다.
프리미엄 구독자는 일일 속보, 프리미엄 기사, 주간 Fundraising & IR Review, Knowledge Bank, LP 프로필 등 모든 콘텐츠를 모바일 플랫폼을 통해 무제한으로 이용할 수 있습니다.
